newsitem.title: USA: Summit Design IPO to offer more shares, cuts price.
newsitem.headline: Summit Design IPO to offer more shares, cuts price.

text.p: Summit Design Inc amended terms of its initial public offering to offer more shares at a lower price, according to a regulatory filing.
The company will offer four million shares in a range of $7 to $9 a share. It initially filed in June for an offering of 3.5 million shares in a range of $8 to $10.
The IPO is due in the week of October 14, according to lead manager Robertson Stephens.
Summit is one of several IPOs which have resurfaced after being taken off the calendar during the summer, a difficult season for many new offerings.
